mission: Tell Luke the full truth about the Ruusan Reformations and accept whatever consequences transparency brings.
why_now: Ben has returned to Coruscant carrying knowledge that could destabilize the Jedi Order. The institutional lie subplot has built across 27 chapters. He must choose: transparency or self-preservation.
conflict: Ben vs. the final choice — what to tell, who to be
turning_point: Ben tells Luke everything. Luke agrees the Order will learn the truth. Ben steps outside, feels his own frequency in the new seal. A note in a chord. Enough.
emotional_trajectory: Choosing a different path isn't betrayal. It's how you honor those who came before — by doing what they couldn't.
notes: Ben tells Luke everything. Luke agrees — the Order will learn the truth. Ben steps out of his father's shadow. Final image: Ben feeling his own frequency in the new seal. A note in a chord. Enough.
